notes: Account: mid-to-large fintech; data residency mandate: EU-only for customer data and logs.
Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with strict encryption posture and KMS integration.
In-transit encryption: require mTLS mutual auth between customer VPC egress and Redwood private connectors; customer will provide CA chain or use CloudHSM-backed certs.
TLS version baseline: TLS1.2 minimum, prefer TLS1.3 for control plane <-> runtime. FIPS endpoints requested for HSM operations.

At-rest: all model artefacts and KV caches must be encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMKs) in AWS KMS; EBS volumes and S3 buckets must be encrypted with CMKs and cross-account key policy reviewed.
Key management: envelope encryption; Redwood to support customer-supplied CMKs + rotation policy. Customer requires proof of key rotation window and rotation audit events.

Secrets management: prefer HashiCorp Vault integration (Transit & KV), or AWS Secrets Manager with IAM role assumption. No long-lived plaintext secrets on nodes; use short-lived mTLS certs + Vault-issued tokens.
Rotation & access: automatic key rotation every 90 days preferred; require ability to trigger emergency rewrap and key compromise playbook.
Audit logging: must forward control-plane and runtime audit logs to customer SIEM in-region (EU) — CloudTrail + application audit events; retention 7 years for compliance team.
Log redaction: PII/token-level masking required in logs; customer wants option to exclude prompt text from logs or store hashed prompt fingerprints only.
Network: private endpoints only, no public ingress. VPC peering or PrivateLink recommended. Customer security prefers PrivateLink due to simpler routing and cross-account permissions.
Compliance: ISO27001 + SOC2 alignment required; customer will run their own penetration test post-deployment and send results back to Redwood.
POC scope: small-scale POC processing anonymized support transcripts, validate latency at 75th percentile <120ms for chat inference under steady load; cost estimate requested for burst scaling.
Quote from CISO on call: "We cannot have keys stored by a third party without cryptographic control — we need CMK ownership and auditable rotations."
Redwood asks: provide detailed KMS key policy template, Vault integration pattern, example mTLS cert rotation flow, and diagram of audit log flow to SIEM.
Internal note: SE to prepare architecture diagram showing envelope encryption, KMS API call flow, and where mTLS is terminated/renegotiated.
Procurement timeline: legal review for DPA and KMS terms underway; target signed SOW by 2026-04-15 if architecture signoff done in March.
Risk: customer has strict network change freeze windows; need early network design session to avoid delays.
